questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Introduction to PyTorch”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not assume that importing torch proves a model is correct; inspect actual tensor values and shapes.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not assume that importing torch proves a model is correct; inspect actual tensor values and shapes.
